description: This PHP file serves as a web page for adding Dynamic DNS (DDNS) entries in a network management interface. It includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP code to present a form, validate user input, dynamically add host name fields, and submit the configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: add1
methods.description: Removes dynamically added host name input fields.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates new input elements for adding additional host names dynamically.
